summary: IHG filed a Form 6-K furnishing a UK TR-1 major-holdings notification (the US equivalent of a Schedule 13G/13D stake disclosure) reporting that Fiera Capital Corporation crossed the disclosure threshold on 11-Sep-2026. Fiera now holds 3,986,586 voting rights, or 2.70% of the issuer, down from a previously notified 3.98% represented entirely by financial instruments; no derivative exposure remains. Notification was dated 17-Sep-2026, filed 18-Sep-2026, and submitted as a correction only to update the issuer notification date from September 15. No board recommendation, advisor, price, premium or deal mechanics are stated; this is a passive stake-change disclosure, not a special situation. Watch for further TR-1 threshold crossings.
